ValidationRule.description: Operations Team Cannot Select Refer to Service Center for Bahrain Region
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Operations_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Operations_Result__c, 'Refer to service center'), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, 'Bahrain'), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Operations Team cannot select 'Refer to Service Center' for the Bahrain Region.
